title: 菊花賞の後に・ゴールはまだ先！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio has the time of her life running in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she hides away and cries over not being able to realize her dream of becoming a Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even through the tears, however, she recognises her own growth during her classic year. Her mood quickly brightens, and we decide on her next race goal…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho. Thus begins Tokai Teio's new journey.
